_comment: Values declared in data that no code reads, accepted for now. The data->code check in validate_data.py fails on anything unread that is NOT listed here, so this file is the record of known gaps rather than a way to silence the check. Shrink it by wiring a consumer, never by adding a line without a reason.

base_bonuses stat._reason: Skill payouts with no consumer yet. `_pct` is a percentage, `party_` means one member's skill pays the whole party (best member — see PartyBonuses), a bare name is flat. What remains is NOT simply unwired; each is blocked on something. morale_pct: no morale system exists — no file in scripts/ mentions the word. charm_effectiveness_pct and social_roll_pct: events carry no check-type tag, so neither can be scoped to the rolls it should affect. loot_quality_pct: no loot rarity mechanic to attach to. max_companions: would replace the hardcoded max_party_size of 8 with a Leadership-driven cap topping out at 5, which is a party-size design change rather than a wiring job. effect_duration_pct: DUPLICATES the live Enchantment mechanic. crafting_quality_pct: no quality concept for crafted items. crafting_yield_pct: owned by Alchemy while crafting reads Smithing. trap_detection_pct: waits on the traps design. See TODO for all of them.

status effect._reason: Behaviour strings on statuses.json entries that no code interprets. Several are one-off mechanics on a single status; `knockback` gains a reader when forced movement lands.
